note: Argentina: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days (some within 180 days or a calendar year: not modelled) or 30 days, extendable; Mercosur citizens may enter on an identity card. Everyone else needs a visa (the electronic travel authorisation for Chinese and others holding a US or Schengen visa isn't modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy of the Dirección Nacional de Migraciones' list.
